subject.title: System prompt should prefer Skill tool over read when available

question: Should OpenClaw support a plugin-provided Skill loader in the native Skills prompt by raw tool name, by an explicit trusted capability or contract, or defer this until the broader skill-contract work is settled?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing how plugin tool output becomes stronger skill-loading authority changes the prompt and plugin trust boundary in a way automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Require explicit Skill-loader capability
options.body: Add a named trusted capability or manifest/SDK contract before changing prompt wording, so only intentionally declared loader tools receive higher prompt authority.

options.title: Use normalized name-based detection
options.body: Treat any available tool named Skill as the loader and update the prompt now, accepting the collision and trust-boundary risk for a smaller change.

options.title: Defer to broader skill parity work
options.body: Keep the read-based prompt until the broader native/Codex and slash-invocation skill-loading contract is decided together.

recommendation.title: Require explicit Skill-loader capability
recommendation.body: Add a named trusted capability or manifest/SDK contract before changing prompt wording, so only intentionally declared loader tools receive higher prompt authority.
